title: Egg Tacos
description: A Mexican-inspired breakfast dish featuring egg-filled tacos with a crispy tortilla.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat.
Add the oil to the skillet and swirl it around.
Add the whisked eggs to the skillet and scramble them until cooked through.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing scrambled eggs onto a tortilla and sprinkling with tortilla seasoning.
